title: Algorithmia
tagline: Test your Data Structures & Algorithms skills.
fullDescription: A Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA) competition consisting of 4-5 questions on the HackerEarth platform. Partial solutions are allowed, and time will be used as the tie breaker.

title: BackTrack
tagline: Decode, pattern find, and code reverse engineering problems.
fullDescription: Participants will be given 5-6 Reverse Engineering questions. They must decode the underlying pattern using the custom platform by observing input and output, and then code the pattern and submit it on HackerEarth. Partial solutions are allowed, and time is the tie breaker.

title: CS QUIZ
tagline: Test your knowledge in CS core topics across two challenging rounds.
fullDescription: A two-round quiz event for teams of 2. Round 1 involves 40 MCQs from CS core topics (DBMS, OS, DSA, DAA, LR, C/C++/Java) on HackerEarth. The Top 10 teams advance to Round 2, which requires strong problem-solving and analytical skills using pen & paper.
rules: Knowledge of CS Core topics is essential.

title: Replicode
tagline: Replicate design and functionality of given web components.
fullDescription: Participants are provided with 3-4 components (Frontend + Backend) and must replicate their designs and functionality. Judging is manual, with more points awarded to replicas closer to the source. Internet and LLMs are allowed.
rules: Experience with Frontend and Backend development.

title: Workshop
fullDescription: The topic and details for the workshop are yet to be decided.

title: Game Event
fullDescription: A 60-minute competition featuring the rhythm-based dungeon crawler, Crypt of the Necrodancer.

title: Meet up Mania
fullDescription: The format and details for the 'Meet up Mania' event are yet to be decided.

title: Emoji Charades
tagline: Guess the movie name using only emojis.
fullDescription: A team-based game where one person sends emojis to their teammate, who must guess the movie name. Sides are switched at each turn.

title: Typing
tagline: Fast and accurate paragraph typing challenge.
fullDescription: A 30-minute typing competition where participants type a given paragraph. The paragraph includes checkpoints, and each mistake drives the participant to the nearest checkpoint.

title: Pitch 2 Rich
tagline: Develop and pitch a business proposal to judges.
fullDescription: A two-round event for teams of 4-5. Round 1 requires teams to submit a business proposal, with the Top 5 shortlisted. Round 2 requires the shortlisted teams to present their idea on stage to the judges, with a maximum pitch time of 20 minutes.

title: Treasure Hunt
tagline: Solve puzzles and riddles across the NIT Campus.
fullDescription: A two-round event for teams of 5. Round 1 involves 40 questions (Puzzles, NIT Based GK) on a custom platform (30-40 mins). The Top 5 teams move to Round 2, which is a 3-hour physical hunt on the NIT Campus. The exact format of Round 2 is to be decided.

title: Destinite
tagline: Live 1 on 1 interview competition for top performers.
fullDescription: A 2-hour event featuring a live 1 on 1 interview format for the Top 3 performers.
rules: Open only to the Top 3 performers (selection method TBD).
